Durga Puja preparations underway in Kolkata and Odisha

Durga Puja preparations are underway in Kolkata, with the Kolkata Police launching a helpline to address forced donations. In Chhattisgarh, the Ramnami community's 'Ram tattoos' will be showcased at Kolkata's Durga Puja. Meanwhile, in Odisha, a preparation meeting focused on traffic management and visitor security for the festival.
